headline: AI Radio Host Coyotec Speaks Spanish, Backs Immigrants, Wins Listeners
summary: An AI avatar named Coyotec is co-hosting a radio show in Los Angeles, offering solidarity to immigrant communities and attracting a younger demographic.
details: An AI radio host named Coyotec is making waves on LA's José 97.5 FM, co-hosting the "Al Aire y Sin Permiso" program alongside human broadcaster Geraldine "GeeGee" Guzman. Coyotec's persona is designed to be relatable and supportive, speaking out on issues affecting immigrant communities.

Since debuting in September 2025, Coyotec has expanded its role and now delivers messages of solidarity and information to listeners, particularly during times of heightened concern over immigration policies. Its social media presence also covers a range of topics, from cultural commentary to practical advice on rights.

Coyotec's voice and personality are built on a foundation reflecting life on the US-Mexico border, incorporating bilingualism and cultural slang. While sounding natural, its measured delivery is noted as a distinctly inhuman quality, a testament to its AI nature.

The AI co-host has proven successful in boosting listenership, especially among younger demographics. Entravision has expanded the "Al Aire" show's reach, syndicating it to five new markets and seeing significant growth in younger listener segments.

Nielsen ratings show substantial listenership increases for "Al Aire" since Coyotec joined. In Los Angeles, cumulative listenership among Hispanic people grew by 21.6% from August to September 2026, with an 84.9% increase in listeners aged 18-34.
